spec.hypothesis: Llama-3.1-8B hires profiling 补救：用 64seq×2048tok 高分辨率 calibration 重做 profiling + constrained MCKP + bf16 eval。类比 exp_e 对 Qwen 的改善 (lowres PPL恶化2.52→hires 0.75, 70%改善)。Pass: MCKP PPL < uniform 4-bit (8.47)。
spec.command: source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/ratekv && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python run_llama_hires_pipeline.py

experiment_data.notes: Hires MCKP (64x2048, max2=18) beats uniform 4-bit on Llama-3.1-8B: 8.4498 vs 8.4690 PPL. Degradation vs bf16 reduced 40.7% compared to lowres (0.3581 vs 0.6033). 255/256 heads got non-zero 2-bit allocation.
